name: restormel-keys
description: Restormel monorepo: Keys (BYOK), Testing runner/CLI, design tokens, dashboard, and integrations.

scripts.check:dashboard: pnpm --filter dashboard run check && pnpm --filter dashboard run build && node scripts/check-testing-dashboard-doc-routes.mjs && node scripts/check-graph-dashboard-doc-routes.mjs
scripts.check:testing: pnpm run typecheck:testing-packages && pnpm run test:testing && pnpm run typecheck:testing-dashboard
scripts.build:platform-packages: pnpm --filter @restormel/contracts run build && pnpm --filter @restormel/context-packs run build && pnpm --filter @restormel/reasoning-core run build && pnpm --filter @restormel/graph-core run build && pnpm --filter @restormel/graphrag-core run build && pnpm --filter @restormel/keys-tokens run build && pnpm --filter @restormel/keys run build && pnpm --filter @restormel/aaif run build && pnpm --filter @restormel/connect-core run build && pnpm --filter @restormel/state run build && pnpm --filter @restormel/observability run build && pnpm --filter @restormel/graph-reasoning-extensions run build
scripts.test:platform-packages: pnpm --filter @restormel/contracts test && pnpm --filter @restormel/context-packs test && pnpm --filter @restormel/reasoning-core test && pnpm --filter @restormel/graphrag-core test && pnpm --filter @restormel/connect-core test && pnpm --filter @restormel/state test && pnpm --filter @restormel/observability test && pnpm --filter @restormel/graph-reasoning-extensions test
